$comment: Every value this package exports, claimed once: as a block (plain name + what it is for), as part of one ("with"), or as internal. Read by scripts/catalogue.mjs; pnpm check:catalogue fails when this file and the package disagree.

blocks.name: Pattern engine
blocks.note: Its results are still labelled with laser operations (cut, score, engrave); those words move to the laser connector when the first 3D pattern app needs the engine.
blocks.for: Fill any shape with a repeating pattern (Japanese, Islamic, lattices, organic, radial, living hinges and the tile library) and get the shapes and lines in millimetres.

blocks.name: Lattice cut
blocks.note: Laser rules (kerf walls, the thinnest wood) living in the pattern package today.
blocks.for: Cut a pattern THROUGH a panel as a lattice: which openings can be cut, which wood must stay, and the status sentence when a pattern will not cut.

blocks.name: Line clipping
blocks.note: @vostok/patterns/clip loads it without the pattern library, for a worker.
blocks.for: Clip lines and shapes to any region without a polygon library, keep them a margin off the edge, and chain or merge the pieces.

blocks.name: Pattern shape maths
blocks.note: Moved to @vostok/shapes (Shape maths, Basic outlines); handed on here, the same functions, so existing imports keep working. Its signedArea is the pattern engine's own summing order (signedAreaClosingFirst there). Import them from @vostok/shapes.
blocks.for: Point-in-shape, nesting loose rings into islands, bounds, and basic outlines (circle, arc, polygon, hexagon, rectangle, slot, star).

blocks.name: SVG path flattener
blocks.note: A second SVG path reader; the SVG reader in @vostok/laser/trace is the main one.
blocks.for: SVG path data (curves and arcs) into straight-segment polylines.

blocks.name: Pattern library
blocks.licence: MIT (Pattern Monster tiles, pattern.monster); licence text in data/
blocks.for: Several hundred ready-made repeating tiles, each with its natural size and a "surprise me" look.

blocks.name: Pattern picker
blocks.for: The chosen pattern as a card with "Choose pattern" and "Surprise me", and the gallery window it opens.
